stem:
The diagram shows Yamini's square garden patch with area $121\,\mathrm{m}^{2}$. She needs the side length of the patch.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The side length is $11\,\mathrm{m}$, the positive square root of $121$.
The square roots of $121$ are $+11$ and $-11$, and $-11\,\mathrm{m}$ can be used as the side length.
The side length produces the perfect square, so the side length is $121\,\mathrm{m}$.
A negative number is an allowed physical side length for this patch.

teacher.key_rationale: 121=11², and a geometric side length is the positive root 11 m. Using −11 omits the positive-length condition. Setting the side equal to the area reverses the square relation. A negative length is outside physical side length.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source as a labelled square garden patch with area 121 m².
